name: @earshot/crm
description: Earshot's CRM adapter SDK, pure TypeScript with no DOM or Node APIs, since the edge Worker imports it: the adapter's types, the error taxonomy (its HTTP mapping, retry advice, and redaction), the idempotency key and write markers, shared planning (§4.3's table, stage reading, times in the rep's zone, the activity line), and the dry run's renderer. Its subpaths: ./testing (the reference CRM, MemoryCrm, and the harnesses), ./conformance (the suite every adapter passes, under Vitest), and ./demo (the demo CRM as an adapter).
